hypotheses.claim: A substitute band (pitch row, electrode row, or pressure row) names an external object.
hypotheses.disconfirm: A pre-registered naming test separates band class from object label and the label is not recovered from the band alone.

hypotheses.claim: An electrotactile tongue row is restored sight.
hypotheses.disconfirm: Users describe buzzing without an object name after training, or an object name appears without the band.
